contract.cleanup: All URL, params, iterator, pattern, array, and result values are request-local. Return from synchronous fetch releases references. No timer, outgoing fetch, binding, durable write, object URL allocation, or retained cross-request capability. External supervisor stops only owned processes and deletes only its fresh deployment/store directory after receipt capture.
contract.desired_behavior: Existing iterator yields a,c,updated d, reports done, then yields e after append and reports done again. Web IDL pair iterators do not latch a completed state.
contract.distinctness: Iterator state across direct list mutation; U206 instead replaces an owning URL record.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['a', '1'], done: false }, 'first iterator yield');
t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['c', '3'], done: false }, 'iterator reads current list after removal of unseen entry');
t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['d', 'updated'], done: false }, 'iterator sees value changed before yield');
t.equal(cursor.next().done, true, 'iterator completes at current end');
t.deep(cursor.next(), { value: ['e', '5'], done: false }, 'pair iterator rechecks the list after previously reporting done');
t.equal(cursor.next().done, true, 'iterator reports done again at the new end');
contract.hypothesis: An iterator may snapshot the initial list, retain a deleted tuple, miss an updated value, or latch completion instead of rechecking the list.
contract.mechanism: Web IDL pair-iterator liveness and list-length rechecking
contract.ordinary_input_scope: Successful public API calls on complete ordinary URL strings or valid property, pair, and pattern inputs. Valid URL nonmatches are intentional boolean/null outcomes, never malformed-input probes. Example domains and documentation IPv6 addresses are data only.
preconditions: Fresh isolated fixture deployment on the exact reviewed direct-celld build; external source/build/process witness required.
Global URL, URLSearchParams, and for U217-U220 URLPattern are supplied by celld, not by Node, a shim, or a mock.
External finite-deadline supervisor and owned-process cleanup are available; missing runtime prerequisites are BLOCKED.
